versions.content: initValue on the level of a ComSpec is relevant for connec- tions to the corresponding PortPrototype Please note that (along the example of sender-receiver communication) only the initValue defined in the context of a ParameterProvideComSpec or ParameterRequireComSpec is relevant for con- nections to the corresponding PortPrototype . An initValue defined in the scope of a ParameterDataPrototype is ignored.
